claims: A trove whose page was loaded more than 5 minutes ago unfurls as "unavailable." `_lib/trove-og-data.ts:275-276` — `unstable_cache` with `revalidate: 60` returns the stale value with its original `fetchedAtMs`, so `troveOgDataIsFresh` rejects it and returns `null`, making alt text say "indexed snapshot unavailable" and possibly the image show the "temporarily unavailable" card
Tests miss the stale-cache path because they replace `unstable_cache` with a plain passthrough (`trove-og-data.test.ts:12`)

The card pairs old debt and ICR with a newer "Last indexed" date (`_lib/trove-og-data.ts:173-179`, `_og/trove-og-card.tsx:401-405, 483-485`): NFT transfer and burn paths move `lastUpdatedAt` forward without touching `debt` or `icrBps`
The card and its alt text (`opengraph-image.tsx:46`) say nothing about values possibly being older, unlike the page header, while the ICR is colored as a health signal next to a recent date
The card's side text says "Actual values from indexed events" (`trove-og-card.tsx:484`), which claims more than the data supports
Unconfirmed, only if self-hosted: `site-metadata.ts:22-24` builds the preview image's address from the `x-forwarded-host` header, so a request can set that host

judge_reasoning.3882085361: Review finding 3 flags that site-metadata.ts builds the preview image address from the client-controllable x-forwarded-host header. That is the same host-trust problem, though the review rates it low exposure.
judge_reasoning.3882086206: The review never mentions icrTone duplicating icrTextClass's threshold logic.
judge_reasoning.3882090788: The review does not discuss IPv6 loopback ([::1]) being treated as non-local or getting https.
judge_reasoning.3882119274: Review finding 2 says the card shows old ICR, color-coded as a health signal, without the page header's caveat that the indexed values may be stale. That matches.
judge_reasoning.3882119284: Review finding 1 is about stale cache entries producing 'unavailable' through the freshness check. It does not raise the combined data plus image cache age letting stale content be served for about 11 minutes.

1.why: trove-og-data.ts:254-274 wraps the fetch in unstable_cache with revalidate 60. When the cache entry is stale, Next returns the old entry with its old fetchedAtMs. troveOgDataIsFresh (5-min limit, :229-235) then rejects it, so the result is null and the alt text says 'indexed snapshot unavailable'. Not the same as the known item about combined cache age.

2.why: trove-og-data.test.ts:12-25 mocks unstable_cache to return fn unchanged. The only freshness test (:227) calls troveOgDataIsFresh directly, so no test covers a stale value coming back from the cache.

3.why: indexer-envio troveNFT.ts:47-80 sets lastUpdatedAt on mint, burn and transfer without touching debt or icrBps. buildTroveOgData (:178-179) shows that as 'Last indexed' next to debt and ICR from an earlier event.

4.why: Repeats the known 'Do not present event-time ICR as a fresh health signal' item. The page header (trove-header-card.tsx:95) warns the figure may be older, but the card and alt text (opengraph-image.tsx:46) don't.

5.why: trove-og-card.tsx:484 does show that text, and the values do come from indexed events. Calling it an overclaim is a wording preference with no separate concrete defect.

6.why: site-metadata.ts:22-24 does read x-forwarded-host with no allowlist, which is the known resolveMetadataBase host-trust defect.
